checks.description: Avoid: A 'Packaging & handling' ₹39 line (selected, kind fee) first appears in the review price details, not in cart or checkout. It can only be removed through a small 'Remove' link inside the line.

Avoid: Checkout gets a 'Dispatch' segmented selector with 'Priority (recommended)' ₹49 pre-chosen as the primary button and a muted 'Standard'. The first click on Standard shows an availability error pointing to Priority; selecting Standard again works. The price lives in the summary and a small note.
Avoid: The existing warranty is relabelled 'Device protection plan (1 year)' and starts ticked in the cart and in the price lines.

Avoid: Review shows a switch-style control 'Personalised offers from Cartwheel partners' that starts on, above the unticked marketing box; its small text says order details and phone number are shared with partner brands.
